gaps: J1: imports kind misclassified usage_contextual instead of import_based — the tier classifier has no 'imports' branch (the TS T1 / JVM K8 finding): every ES6/require/re-export dependency edge falls to usage_contextual

J2: dynamic import('./lazy') emits a spurious calls -> import edge and NO imports edge for the module — TS7 was closed in the TS wave; the JS dynamic-import fixture currently documents the bug as accepted
J3: string interpolation `${x}` emits no Uses on the interpolated identifiers (TS3 T3 / kotlin K4 / scala G4 analog)

J4: obj.method() emits BOTH calls (obj.method -> method) AND uses (obj -> method, isFieldAccess) — the family contract (TS/kotlin/scala) skips the callee in uses because calls covers it; JS double-emits
J5: calls inside static { } blocks attribute to the MODULE, not the enclosing class — kotlin K7 init-attribution analog
J6: top-level const r = x instanceof T attributes the reference to 'global' instead of r — the resolveSource walk lacks variable_declarator (TS fixed this in the same wave)
J7: module-level destructured bindings (const { a } = obj / const [b] = arr) emit NO symbols — TS emits them as constants (probe-verified parity gap)

J8: JSX component usage emits NOTHING — <Button/> produces no edges. JSX is native to the JS grammar (8 types in the gate enumeration), unlike TS where it is a separate tsx dialect; the analyzer's detectsJsx only sets a pattern flag

gaps: V1: script-setup compiler macros in the TYPE-LITERAL generic form — defineProps<{ id: string }>() and defineEmits<{ (e: 'save'): void }>() — emit NO prop/event symbols. Only the runtime object/array form ({ size: Number } / ['change']) is extracted; the standard Vue 3.3+ generic form loses the entire public contract.

V2: template expressions emit NO references to the component's own members — {{ count }}, @click="onSave", :label="label", v-model="count", v-if="show" read script-side state but no Uses/references edge is emitted. The template<->script data-flow is entirely silent.

V3: duplicate contains edges — the JS/TS sub-analyzer already emits contains for script-side symbols (class -> method), and the vue analyzer's own contains pass re-emitted them, doubling every class member's containment edge in the analyzer output (the store dedupes at INSERT, but the analyzer result and any consumer of it saw 2x).
